title: ProDuh! Proposal Workshop – Problem, Target User, MVP

transcript.text: Goal today: leave with a crisp problem statement, a target user, and a thinnest-possible MVP.
From CS calls: teams have decks with goals but devs can’t see the why in tickets. Weekly updates are manual.
We need focus. If we do everything, we’ll do nothing well. What’s the first painful gap we solve?
Foggy problem definition. We enforce one problem + one target user. Everything else hangs off that.
Data is weak. Propose allowing manual KPI baselines and CSV import, then compute deltas and trends.
Frontend can show a KPI ribbon on every story card. Click reveals the narrative of why it matters.
Backend MVP can be a small ingestion service and a summarizer. Read-only to Jira/Confluence for now.
Draft problem statement: "Teams can’t connect strategy to daily work, so outputs don’t reflect goals." Target user: PM/Tech Lead pair.
Measure success by % of tickets linked to a goal and weekly narrative freshness. Keep scope small.
MVP features: Evidence intake → Goals/KPIs draft → Traceability view → Weekly narrative.
KPIs v1: 1) % issues linked to a goal, 2) Days since last narrative, 3) Cycle time from discovery to delivery.
Decision principles: if a feature doesn’t clarify the why or the next step, it’s out for v1.
Approved to continue. Keep read-only integrations; prove value with narratives and traceability.

decisions: Problem statement and target user approved.
MVP scope: Evidence intake → Goals/KPIs draft → Traceability → Weekly narrative.
KPIs: goal linkage %, narrative freshness, discovery→delivery cycle time.

actionItems.summary: Update CONF-001 with approved problem, user, MVP, KPIs.
Define minimal data model for goals, KPIs, and narratives.
Provide CSV template + example baselines for MVP KPIs.
